working_definition: Author type 'LC10b' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult lobula columnar neuron LC10b (Özel et al., 2021).

justification: 'LC10b' is FBbt:00111745 'lobula columnar neuron LC10b'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so its immature form FBbt:00053672 (FBbt #2219, release 2026-11-02).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a lobula columnar neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent of the new immature LC10b term (used until FBbt #2219 was released).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Subtype of lobula columnar neuron LC10A. It has its main arbors in lobula layers 4 to 6, with arbors denser in the latter, and many parallel processes exist between the two layers. Presynaptic sites are mainly observed in layer 6, with some in layers 4 and 5A. It is a cholinergic neuron (Davis et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form, used from the pharate adult stage; no immature form in FBbt.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053672 'immature lobula columnar neuron LC10b' (exact match).
